newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura declines to confirm report of profit fall. [CORRECTED 7:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Nomura declines to confirm report of profit fall. [CORRECTED 7:20 GMT]

text.p: Nomura Securities Co Ltd declined on Monday to confirm a newspaper report that the company's parent current profit in the April-June period declined seven percent to around 34 billion yen.
A spokeswoman for Nomura said the company will announce its earnings for the quarter on Thursday.

The business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Sunday that the quarterly earnings of Japan's biggest brokerage did not fall significantly despite the recent scandal concerning illegal payoffs to a corporate racketeer.
The paper said firm's profits in bond trading and cost-cutting measures partly compensated for declines in revenues from stock broking fees and corporate bond underwriting fees.

The company's stock dealing income in the April-June quarter declined about 40 percent from the same period in the previous year, while revenues from underwriting of corporate bonds fell about 80 percent, the paper said.
